body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Eton presented ’Sound 101’, its new tabletop radio to combine digital AM and FM tuning with an iPod docking station and SIRIUS satellite radio capability during 2007 CES Unveiled.

It also introduced another table top radio with USB port and SD card slot. It is available in black, silver, and white colors. While ‘eton’ comes from a Greek word, it is actually a US-based company specializing in audio products with a head-quarter located in Palo Alto, California, USA.
